verdict.rationale: Bench's own docs describe an AI Categorization Assistant that suggests transaction categories in real time from a user's description, and pattern-based automatic categorization rules. This is real in-product AI suggestion, but it is limited to bookkeeping categorization rather than broader AI-generated insights about the user's finances. Reports are standard statements and dashboards with no AI analysis described. Missing for 10: AI-generated financial insights or recommendations beyond categorization (e.g., spending or cash-flow analysis), a conversational way to ask questions of the data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Just describe the purpose of the transaction, and the AI Categorization Assistant identifies it in real-time.
Insights from your business patterns automatically generate categorization rules, minimizing your tasks in the future.
Smart categorization: uses your transactions, receipts, and past actions to categorize most transactions automatically.
